thread:
Maria Ramos: @channel kicking off an express onboarding for ExpressCorp — 14-day quickstart. Goal: integrate Redwood API for chat + embeddings and ship an internal demo by Day 12. High-level stakeholders: Leah (PM), Samir (Eng), Juan (CS).

Juan Perez: Thanks — quick Q: are we scoped to hosted API only or do they need VPC/Dedicated options? Need to know for keys/whitelisting.

Maria Ramos: Hosted API for the spike. They may evaluate Dedicated later. Juan — can you own API key setup + initial rate limits? We should set soft quotas for the pilot.

Samir Patel: I can own infra + onboarding tech. Will do a 2-day spike for model selection and baseline prompts. Suggest we start with a lightweight open model baseline (redwood-alpha) for perf.

Leah Chen: Success criteria to confirm: 1) Internal demo achieves median latency < 300ms for 512 tokens; 2) Embedding retrieval quality: mean cosine >= 0.85 on our eval set; 3) Error rate < 1% for a 2k daily request volume simulation. Also capture customer satisfaction via a short post-demo survey.

Maria Ramos: Noted. Renewal risk flags to watch: low post-demo usage, latency regressions, and onboarding docs friction. We'll run weekly health checks and a post-demo NPS to surface early churn signals.

OnboardBot: New meeting scheduled: ExpressCorp Enablement — Mon 09 Mar 2026 14:00 PT — calendar invite sent.

Juan Perez: I'll run the first enablement session on Wed. Draft agenda: intro, auth, rate limits, playground walkthrough, sample integration. Anyone want to add?

Samir Patel: Add KV-cache recommendations and batching guidance. I'll prepare curl + node examples and a small reference repo.

Maria Ramos: Owners & tentative deadlines: API keys & quotas (Juan) — Day 1; test prompt set + eval harness (Samir) — Day 3; internal demo build (Leah) — Day 10; public/customer demo (team) — Day 12; post-demo survey & capture (Maria) — Day 13. I'll keep a living checklist in the onboarding doc.

Maria Ramos: Schedule snapshot:
```
Day 0: kickoff (this thread)
Day 1: keys + quota + initial auth
Day 3: model baseline + eval results
Day 6: integration spike + office hours
Day 10: internal demo (stakeholders)
Day 12: customer demo
Day 13: feedback survey + action items
```

Leah Chen: :thumbsup: Can we add two 30-min office hours during week 2 for pre-demo support? Might reduce last-minute blockers.

Maria Ramos: Yes — I'll put them on the calendar. Also, please log any feature requests or connector asks in #product-feedback so we can triage.

Juan Perez: Will do. FYI — renewal risk: ExpressCorp flagged SSO & SOC2 as must-haves for procurement. We should loop in Security for a quick SOC2 readiness note.

Samir Patel: I can draft a SOC2 readiness checklist + templated scope for them. Will post in the doc by EOD.

Maria Ramos: Perfect. Next steps: owners please acknowledge in-thread. I will lock the timeline tomorrow if no objections and send the stakeholder invite and doc link.

Leah Chen: Ack.

Juan Perez: Ack.

Samir Patel: Ack.
